svg.title: What the bot-health bot does when a bot fails
svg.desc: When a run of a bot or a scheduled workflow ends on the default branch, the bot-health bot looks at it; runs of pull requests start nothing. A first failure that a second try can fix runs its failed jobs once more. A failure that stays opens one issue for the workflow, or updates it, with the failed jobs, their steps and their first errors. A run that passes closes the issue. Every night, the bot looks at the latest run of every workflow, in case GitHub lost an event, but leaves a workflow that keeps an issue of its own to that issue. It starts a workflow whose schedule GitHub missed or switched off: one with no run of its schedule or by hand since the time of its schedule, whatever pushes ran it since.
